name: cavalier_of_dawn_no_target_makes_no_golem
note: Cavalier of Dawn: 'When this creature enters, destroy up to one target nonland permanent. Its controller creates a 3/3 colorless Golem artifact creature token.' Its controller designates no target (NONE: 'up to one' allows zero, CR 115.6), so nothing is destroyed and 'its controller' names nobody: no Golem (CR 608.2b). Red before 2026-11-13 (with this record): CREATE_TOKEN raised 'controller role resolved to 0 players'.
